name: mt_bench_ppl_large
description: mt_bench_ppl_large measures language model performance via perplexity on large-scale multilingual/translation-related text corpora, focusing on large models' fluency and generalization. It is intended to compare language-modeling capabilities across model sizes and training conditions. The benchmark emphasizes perplexity as a primary automatic metric for ranking models.
reputation: Relatively obscure dataset with limited but growing use in language-model evaluation circles.
